name: guardrails
description: A lint gate for Claude's edits: your project's rules, a baseline of existing violations, and a PreToolUse check that refuses only edits adding new ones.

mode.title: When an edit adds a violation
mode.description: block refuses the edit and tells Claude which rules it broke; warn lets it through and shows a toast.

paths.title: Files the gate covers
paths.description: Comma-separated globs, relative to the project root (**, *, ?, {a,b}). Each rule also has its own paths.

rulesFile.title: Rules file
rulesFile.description: The project's rules, relative to the project root. Empty: .claude/guardrails.toml, else .claude/guardrails.json.

baselineFile.title: Baseline file
baselineFile.description: Where existing violations are recorded (guard.py baseline). Only violations not in it fail.

python.title: Python
python.description: The Python 3.9+ executable that runs the rules (python, python3, py, or a full path). TOML rules need 3.11+.
